label: Rival: something HAS_INTELLECT_1 without HAS_WILL_1 (purely contemplative intellect)
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by accounts of a purely contemplative first intellect, by the denial that God acts from freedom of will, and by necessary emanation: something has intellect and does not have will. The replacement account of how anything proceeds from such an intellect is necessity of nature, not volition; the formal statement does not express that account. It is the exact negation of STMT-WILL-FOLLOWS-INTELLECT on the same two predicates. It does not say that no intellect has will.
